target_customer: High mix contract manufacturers whose production lines change often
problem: Traditional automation and current vision language action models fail when factory lines change weekly, so robots are hard to retask.
business_model: Robot hardware, model and on site deployment sold to factories, pricing not public

founders.name: Navid Aghasadeghi
founders.background_notes: YC page: senior staff engineer at Boston Dynamics who helped bring Spot to commercial deployment, principal engineer at Rethink.

founders.name: Mojtaba Mozaffar
education: PhD in Mechanical Engineering and Robotics, Northwestern
founders.background_notes: YC page: senior applied scientist and tech lead at Amazon Robotics, research assistant professor at Northwestern.

competitors.name: Skild AI
competitors.what: Robot foundation model S1 that learns tasks from a single video
competitors.traction_then: Company claimed a $100M annual run rate in August 2026 and a Foxconn deployment

competitors.name: Generalist AI
competitors.what: GEN-1.5 model learning from a single short demonstration

technical_complexity.rationale: One shot learning of new manipulation tasks on a real line is research grade, and large funded labs are racing on the same capability.

defensibility.rationale: Founders have deep robotics pedigree, but model capability is contested by far larger labs and no proprietary data advantage is documented.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Skild and Generalist announced single demonstration models in August 2026, weeks after the batch started.

market_need_then: Contract manufacturers face frequent line changes and labor shortages, and 2026 saw heavy investor interest in robot foundation models.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand. The name is also a wine grape and a city, which hurts search distinctiveness, though no source discusses it.

outcome_analysis: Shiraz AI joined YC in Summer 2026 with two senior robotics founders and no exit or failure yet. Its site says robots already run at customer sites but names none and discloses no funding. Within weeks of the batch, Skild AI and Generalist AI announced single demonstration models, so the main risk is being out-resourced on model quality while it sells deployments to contract manufacturers.
notes: Funding unverified: Dealroom lists a $125k seed with no investors, marked as AI generated text, single aggregator, so no round recorded. Education came from the YC page.
